browser.externalCheckpoint: separate local durable SQLite reference; no production service
browser.tls: disposable SPKI pin; node CA and hostname validation

protocol.initialization: explicit trusted control and empty identity database only; no runtime DDL
order: compare accepted SQL head and complete 12-table digest
trusted SQL work and new head in same transaction
confirmed SQL COMMIT and client release
protocol.unknown_commit: no result; reservation stays pending; no automatic release/retry/reconcile
protocol.rollback: confirmed rollback permits abort; fence never reused
protocol.lost_external_ack: no result; pending if not sealed; subsequent exact accepted state can proceed if seal actually committed
protocol.coverage: whole SQL identity database across tenant/issuer/audience; every configured read/write; unconfigured writers not covered
protocol.digest: PG to_jsonb(row)::text + C order + table/row count + UTF-8 length; exact profile; not signature
protocol.durability: separate private SQLite file, DELETE journal+synchronous EXTRA; ordinary restart, two connections, killed child process; not power-loss certification
